nodes.name: Switch swsrv
startup: for i in eth0 eth1; do ip link set "$i" up 2>/dev/null || true; done; ip link show br0 >/dev/null 2>&1 || ip link add br0 type bridge || true; for i in eth0 eth1; do ip link set "$i" master br0 2>/dev/null || true; done; ip link set br0 up 2>/dev/null || true
ip addr replace 10.0.0.2/24 dev br0 2>/dev/null || ip addr replace 10.0.0.2/24 dev eth0 2>/dev/null || true
